releaseNotes.en: First quickstart help package with English and Simplified Chinese documents.
releaseNotes.zh-Hans: 首版快速上手帮助包，包含英文与简体中文文档。

releaseNotes.en: First model metadata notes: capability and reasoning-effort guidance, with no model weights or download URLs.
releaseNotes.zh-Hans: 首版模型元数据说明：记录能力与推理强度对照，不包含模型权重或下载地址。

releaseNotes.en: Content prompt sections (remotely updateable): stable method, communication and delivery sections that replace their compiled counterpart. Fixed safety, permission, tool-protocol and mode rules cannot be updated remotely.
releaseNotes.zh-Hans: 内容型提示词分区（可远程更新）：方法、沟通与交付三个稳定分区，替换对应内置段落。固定安全、权限、工具协议与模式规则不可远程更新。

releaseNotes.en: Adds Google Gemini conversation service, refreshes chat model candidates and keeps image services separate. Existing configurations are preserved.
releaseNotes.zh-Hans: 新增 Google Gemini 对话服务，更新聊天模型目录，并保留独立的图片服务。已有配置保持不变。

releaseNotes.en: Search provider catalog: adds DeepSeek's official web search with long summaries and optional page content; existing entries and saved configurations are unchanged.
releaseNotes.zh-Hans: 搜索服务目录：新增 DeepSeek 官方网页搜索（长摘要与可选网页正文），其余条目与已保存配置不变。

releaseNotes.en: First report template with bilingual guidance and a ready-to-use Markdown structure.
releaseNotes.zh-Hans: 首版报告模板，提供中英双语说明与可直接使用的 Markdown 结构。
